messages:
Sam: Heads up — I'm sketching a new Serving QoS dashboard that folds runtime latency, KV-cache stats, routing policy counters, and quota/usage. Need cross-team input on which raw metrics infra/runtime should emit and what the RBAC/sharing model looks like for internal vs customer views. Anyone?
Maya: On it. For metrics, p50/p95/p99, cold_start_count, kv_cache_hit_rate, mean_batch_size, tokens_emitted. Also: per-route request_count and error_count.
Jordan: Add fallback_count (when smart routing falls back to cheaper model) and region_routing_rate (percent routed to each region). We also need a model_variant label.
Priya: We can surface those from the infra side but exposing per-tenant identifiers as-is is problematic. Suggest emitting tenant labels as `tenant_hash` for public views and `tenant_id` for internal. That requires a Prom exporter change. Example relabel config:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
  target_label: tenant_hash
  replacement: "${namespace_hash}"
  action: replace
```
Sam: That matches what I was thinking. Product requirement: two dashboard modes — INTERNAL (full labels + cost) and CUSTOMER_SAFE (no raw tenant ids, no cost metrics, mask user identifiers). RBAC: a new role flag `view_sensitive_metrics` that gates INTERNAL visibility.
Leo: Security POV: redact tenant_id for customer-facing dashboards unless there's an explicit share consent. Audit trail required for any share/grant/revoke events. Log must include actor_id, timestamp, dataset_id, and previous_grant_state.
Anika: UX idea: default dashboard shares to "internal only". For customer sharing, require a lightweight approval flow (owner + security) and show a preview of masked data. Also add a per-dashboard "masking level" dropdown: None / Partial / Full.
Jordan: Implementation note — runtime will emit counters with labels `policy_id`, `route_id`, `model_variant`, `tenant_hash`. We'll add a `fallback_reason` label for postmortem tallying. Also counters should be monotonic for accurate deltas.
Priya: On the infra PR side: we'll add labels `team_id`, `policy_id`, and `route_id` to the Prom exporter. For customer-facing endpoints we'll conditionally strip `team_id`/`tenant_id` based on feature flag `customer_view_masking`. Planning PR by Mon 2026-03-23.
Maya: Can we also expose `token_count` per request and a derived `cost_estimate_usd` (agg)? Redwood Optimize needs token-level cost signals. Internal-only for now.
Sam: Action items so we're aligned:
- Priya: open exporter PR to add labels + masking flag (due Mon 3/23).
- Jordan: instrument fallback_count, region_routing_rate, and fallback_reason labels (due Wed).
- Leo: draft audit-log schema for share/grant/revoke and masking change events (due Tue).
- Anika: mockup sharing UX + masking levels for console (deliverable: Figma file, due Fri).
- Maya: enumerate final metric names and units and send proto list into #telemetry (due Thu).
Priya: I'll open the PR and post the link here when ready.
Jordan: Quick note — quota counters need `policy_id` and must be exported as `quota_used_total` (monotonic) for correct alerting and rollouts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag `dashboard-rbac-metrics-v2` toggled on in staging at 1793001200
Leo: :thumbsup: Also ensure the audit log includes the actor's ip/device if available.
Sam: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed 09:00 PT to walk the UX + infra plan. Invite incoming.
Maya: I'll prepare the metric sheet and include example Grafana panels + alert thresholds.
Anika: I'll add the approval flow steps into the mockup (owner -> security -> ops).
Sam: Perfect. If anything blocks PRs, tag me and I'll escalate.
